# Extraction Checklist: Recipe Extraction Assistant Adapter

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements in the extraction spec: are the outcomes, rules, limits and failure classes written completely, clearly and consistently enough to implement and review the adapter (S-015) and to build the capture feature (S-016) against it?
**Created**: 2026-10-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [contracts/recipe-extraction-port.md](../contracts/recipe-extraction-port.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Depth**: Standard. **Audience**: PR reviewer of the S-015 change.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the shape of the draft recipe (title, servings, categories, ingredient lines, steps) defined in the spec itself, or only by reference to "the same shape the capture feature shows"? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, Gap]
- [x] CHK002 Are validation rules defined for the draft title and steps, or does FR-006 cover only units, sizes, lines, names, servings and categories? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Gap]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for what the "not a recipe" reason may contain and how long it may be? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Gap]
- [x] CHK004 Is the content of the "limit reached" wait hint specified (unit, format, and what happens when it is absent or unreadable)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for how base servings are estimated, including the value used and how the "estimated" flag is set? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1, Scenario 4]
- [x] CHK006 Is the set of "closest allowed unit" mappings written out, or only the single example "tablespoon" → "tbsp"? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Gap]
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements stated for the input kinds that are out of scope (URL, photo) beyond the timeout defaults, given that Assumptions say only text input is in scope? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK008 Is the "request reference" that logs must carry (FR-014) defined: its format, source, and whether it is the same across the request? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Gap]
- [x] CHK009 Are requirements defined for the behaviour when the configured model name is missing or unknown, as distinct from a missing key? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK010 Is "vague" amount defined with explicit criteria (which phrases count, such as "a pinch of" or "to taste"), or is it left to the reader of PRD §1.6? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 1, Scenario 1, Ambiguity]
- [x] CHK011 Is "valid" category defined (against the allowed set, the kitchen's catalog, or both), since FR-006 and the edge cases use the word without criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Is the rule "prefer categories already in the kitchen" specified with an ordering or tie-break when several categories are valid and some are new? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 1, Scenario 3, Gap]
- [x] CHK013 Is "more than one recipe" defined precisely enough to tell a multi-recipe text from a single recipe with sub-sections (for example "for the sauce")? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 2]
- [x] CHK014 Is "one recipe at a time" stated as the exact reason text, or only as a paraphrase? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 2, Scenario 2]
- [x] CHK015 Is the "lower-case, singular" ingredient name rule defined for pasted text in a language other than the kitchen's, given that the draft keeps the text's language? [Conflict, Spec §User Story 1, Scenario 2, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK016 Is "quantity greater than zero" specified for ranges ("2–3 onions"), fractions and words ("a dozen"), or are these undefined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Gap]
- [x] CHK017 Is "whitespace-only" defined, and is the 10,000-character limit specified as counted before or after trimming, and in characters or bytes? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK018 Is "closest allowed unit" defined as a rule (lookup table, rule of thumb or fallback), so that two implementers would map the same input the same way? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK019 Is "structurally valid" (FR-005, User Story 3 Scenario 4) defined against a stated schema, or only in terms of "the expected structure" with no reference? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Dependency]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK020 Do the category rules agree across the spec, the Clarifications and the plan's Known tension note (up to 6, may be none, never a failure)? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK021 Do the category counts stated in the PRD references (§1.6, §1.7, §2 J2, Appendix B.1) match the spec, given that the spec says they were updated in the same change? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Dependency]
- [x] CHK022 Is the timeout default for text input (10 s) stated the same way in FR-013, SC-005, the plan's Performance Goals and the Clarifications? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK023 Is the "unavailable" rule for timeouts (FR-003) consistent with the rule that a missing key also returns "unavailable" (Edge Cases), given that one is a service condition and the other a configuration condition? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK024 Does the "no raw service error text" rule (User Story 3 Scenario 6, FR-008, SC-006) agree with what the failure results may carry, such as a wait hint or a reason? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK025 Is the rule that a unit outside the allowed set is mapped rather than rejected (FR-006) consistent with the rule that an invalid line makes the whole draft "invalid output" (User Story 1, Scenario 1)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Spec §User Story 3]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK026 Can SC-002 ("on every attempt") be objectively measured given that model output varies between calls, and is the size of the "manual evaluation set" defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK027 Is SC-004 (injected-instruction inputs) backed by a defined evaluation set or pass threshold, rather than only "manual evaluation runs"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Gap]
- [x] CHK028 Is SC-005 ("within the configured wait plus one second") specified for image input, where the wait is 30 s, and for a request whose connection is slow rather than silent? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK029 Is SC-007 ("no extraction call creates or changes a record") specified against a defined set of tables or stores, or only by the feature's "stores nothing" statement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, Spec §FR-011]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK030 Are requirements defined for each of the three failure classes when the service returns a partial result (some lines valid, some not)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Gap]
- [x] CHK031 Are requirements defined for a result that is "not a recipe" and also contains a usable recipe fragment? [Coverage, Ambiguity]
- [x] CHK032 Are requirements defined for a retry after a failure, beyond the statement that the member presses "try again" and the text stays in the box? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications, Gap]
- [x] CHK033 Are requirements defined for concurrent calls that hit the usage limit at the same time? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK034 Are requirements defined for text that is exactly 10,000 characters, and for text one character over? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK035 Are requirements defined for an ingredient size given with the unit "unit" but an unlisted value (for example "huge")? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK036 Are requirements defined for a base servings value of 0, a negative value, or a non-integer value from the service? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK037 Are requirements defined for categories whose names differ only by case or surrounding spaces, beyond the de-duplication rule? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-006, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK038 Are privacy requirements defined for the pasted text beyond "not stored" and "not logged in full" (for example, whether it is sent to the provider as-is and what the provider may retain)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Gap]
- [x] CHK039 Are prompt-injection requirements specified for the output side (for example, what the adapter must do when the result contains instructions or text outside the schema), not only for the input delimiters? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, Gap]
- [x] CHK040 Are retry-related requirements consistent with the SDK's built-in retry, which the plan disables, and is the requirement that "exactly one attempt" applies to every outcome written in the spec? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Design Decisions 5]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK041 Is the "answer from recipes only" rule from the constitution (§5) explicitly excluded from this feature in the spec, or only in the plan? [Assumption, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK042 Is the dependence on the PRD for the recipe rules (§1.6) documented with a version or date, so that a later PRD change does not silently change the rules in this spec? [Dependency, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK043 Is the assumption that the provider (Gemini) supports a structured response schema documented as a requirement or as a research finding, with a stated fallback if it does not? [Assumption, Plan §Design Decisions 3]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK044 Is the spec's use of "draft" consistent with the shape in data-model.md and the port contract, so that S-016 can build against one definition? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, Dependency]
- [x] CHK045 Is it stated whether the port contract (contracts/recipe-extraction-port.md) is normative for S-016 or informative, and where a conflict between it and the spec would be resolved? [Conflict, Gap]

## Coverage of Spec Amendments (added 2026-10-20)

- [x] CHK046 Does FR-006a define how a unit is matched when the service returns a plural, mixed-case or accented form (for example "Tazás", or "gr." with a period)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006a]
- [x] CHK047 Is the Spanish "libra" → `lb` mapping stated with its weight, given that "libra" denotes different weights in different Spanish-speaking regions? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006a]
- [x] CHK048 Is it specified whether the unit table applies only to ingredient quantities, or also to units written inside step text? [Scope, Spec §FR-006a, Gap]
- [x] CHK049 Is it specified how a non-vague ingredient line with no unit at all (an empty unit, not an unlisted one) is handled? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, Gap]
- [x] CHK050 Are the message texts for each failure class and action (FR-015) defined, or is that left to S-016 with no shared list? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Dependency]
- [x] CHK051 Is the title limit (FR-006b, 200 characters) specified with a counting method (trimmed or raw, characters or code points), in line with the same gap in CHK017? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006b]
- [x] CHK052 Is the wait-hint rule (FR-004) specified for values the service returns as zero, negative or fractional? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004, Gap]
- [x] CHK053 Is it specified whether a configuration error is detected at startup or on each call, given that the edge case says every call returns it? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK054 Do FR-001, User Story 3 and Key Entities use the same four class names, and is the wording "exactly one of" still correct with the fourth class? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK055 Do the existing items CHK004, CHK023, CHK032 and CHK034 still match the amended spec, or do they need revision? [Consistency, Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`; this file is not affected by it
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference (CHK001–CHK055)
